reader.requirement: At --std 85 a PERFORM that omits procedure-name-1 (any of Formats 1-4) must carry imperative-statement-1 and END-PERFORM, and a PERFORM that names procedure-name-1 (with or without THRU and with any TIMES/UNTIL/VARYING phrase) must carry neither.

edition-consulted.switches: {is2023()}? bare LOCATION head; below 2023 PERFORM LOCATION is an out-of-line PERFORM

reader.edition-search: The SR1 cardinality itself is grammar-only: inline alternative `PERFORM performInlineHead? statementBlock ... END_PERFORM` (statementBlock required) and out-of-line alternatives with no body or END_PERFORM; no predicate on those alternatives. Edition consults found only for the 2023 Format-3 form (grep is2023/VisitPerform in the grammar and VersionConformancePass).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the presence/absence rule is the same at every edition; only the 2023 Format-3 inline form is gated off at 85
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness exercises an inline VARYING; not exercised are an out-of-line PERFORM followed by a body or END-PERFORM, an inline PERFORM missing END-PERFORM or the body, and the THRU/TIMES out-of-line forms

probes.printed: P1 / P1 P2 / IN / T T / P1 P1 / 02 / V01 V02 / P1 P2 (exit 0)
probes.expected: out-of-line forms without body and inline forms (plain, TIMES, TEST AFTER UNTIL, VARYING) with body and END-PERFORM accepted and run

probes.printed: COBOL0306 unexpected 'END-PERFORM' (PERFORM P1 DISPLAY "X" END-PERFORM); same for pf1r2 (PERFORM P1 END-PERFORM), pf1r3 (P1 2 TIMES ... END-PERFORM), pf1r7 (P1 THRU P2 ... END-PERFORM)
COBOL2269 unexpected '.' (PERFORM DISPLAY "X". with no END-PERFORM); pf1r8 (PERFORM UNTIL N > 1 ADD 1 TO N.) same
COBOL2072 imperative-statement required (PERFORM END-PERFORM); pf1r6 (2 TIMES END-PERFORM) and pf1r10 (VARYING ... END-PERFORM) same
COBOL0900 Format-3 (exception-checking) PERFORM requires COBOL-2023; COBOL0878 EC-ALL requires 2002
probes.expected: the 2023 inline form with WHEN phrases is not a 1985 format

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.21.3 SR1  (6.21.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1

reader.notes: The grammar carries SR1: no out-of-line alternative takes a body or END-PERFORM, and the inline alternative requires both. Every violation probed is refused; the missing-END-PERFORM case is diagnosed as an unexpected period after the body statement rather than naming END-PERFORM (diagnosis wording only).

refuter.evidence: At --std 85: rp1r1 PERFORM P1 UNTIL N > 1 ADD 1 TO N END-PERFORM (Format 3 with procedure-name and body) refused COBOL0306; rp1r2 Format 4 PERFORM P1 VARYING ... DISPLAY END-PERFORM refused COBOL0306; rp1r4 PERFORM P1 WITH TEST AFTER UNTIL ... body END-PERFORM refused COBOL0306; rp1r3 inline WITH TEST AFTER UNTIL with no imperative statement refused COBOL2072. rp1pos: PERFORM 2 TIMES PERFORM P1 END-PERFORM (out-of-line PERFORM as the body of an inline one, END-PERFORM closes the outer) accepted and printed P1 P1; nested inline PERFORMs and PERFORM P1 THRU P2 K TIMES inside an inline VARYING ran (K01 K01 / P1 P2 P1 P2). Reader's pf1r9 already covers the 2023 Format-3 form. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.21.3 SR1 the text is in SR1.
